li.label: a tickling throat
li.description: There's a dry tickle at the back of my throat that won't go away. It's the spores.

li.label: spore cough
li.description: I cough every few breaths, and it tastes of mushrooms.

li.label: a dull headache
li.description: My head feels stuffed with wool. It's the fumes off the ground.

li.label: a fume headache
li.description: My head is pounding, and the air tastes of the seeps.
